conditions.wake: ace.js perch: the plane crossed wakeWhen.x (or the aerodrome scrambles) - e.stage toLane / chase / climb
conditions.in_cone: ace.js startTelegraph: e.fire set (event telegraph, attack 'darts': the hot-pink halo + the rising whine); the game indexes it by e.fire.t
conditions.volley_done: e.fire back to null (TELEGRAPH 0.5 s + three darts 0.15 s apart)
conditions.graze: motifs/wingman.js: the plane's wake touched it - e.spun 0 .. 0.35 s + the turret (the game cartwheels the sprite)
conditions.downed: combat.js defeat (the turret after a spin, or hp 0 by the nose gun) - e.state 'dazed', stage 'downed'
conditions.landed: ace.js stepDowned: it reached the first solid below - e.sat
conditions.reset: ace.js resetAces: the plane respawned - every Ace still flying back to its perch
conditions.respawn: the entity is back after a level reset (checkpoint / retry)
